title: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
author: Dale Carnegie
blurb: Dale Carnegie wrote this book after seeing how much worry quietly ruined people's lives, including his own students'. He gathered stories from ordinary people and famous figures, plus wisdom from philosophers and doctors, and boiled it down to simple habits anyone can use. He says to live one day at a time instead of drowning in past regrets and future fears. He gives a step-by-step method for facing problems: get the facts, decide, then act. He urges readers to stay busy, check the odds before panicking, accept what cannot be changed, and stop replaying old mistakes. He also argues that our thoughts shape our happiness, so we should count our blessings and turn setbacks into gains. Finally, he shows that helping others is one of the surest cures for worry.

lessons.b: Close the doors on yesterday and tomorrow and give your full attention to today, because that is the only day you can actually live.

input_title: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
